description: A minimal app bundled with esbuild + @afterpack/esbuild (single ESM outfile). Proves the esbuild bundle survives obfuscation: the page renders and the counter interaction (obfuscated #private-field class) still works in chromium.

build.note: node build.mjs bundles src/main.js -> dist/app.js, obfuscated by @afterpack/esbuild's onEnd hook (build.backup:false)

interactions.description: Clicking the counter runs the obfuscated bundle's #private-field class and re-renders.
